flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3100/signin?demo=1 then Click the "Sign in" button
Go to http://localhost:3100/app/shield
Type "AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx" into the "Paste a Solana address" field
Click "Check address"
Assert the result says "Blocked"
Assert the result says it looks like Ada’s saved address but isn’t

remark: click: Clicking the Sign in button
wait: PRIMARY: wait 1000 ms for sign-in to finish
wait: queued plan (2 steps): type "Solana address to check"; click "Check address"
type: Type "AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx" into "Solana address to check
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the address check result to appear
analyze: The result says it looks like Ada’s saved address but isn’t.
assert: the result says it looks like Ada’s saved address but isn’t

summary:
The requested sign-in step was completed, then the Shield page was opened.
Entered the provided Solana address and checked it.
The address check was completed successfully: it was marked “Blocked” and identified as looking like Ada’s saved address without being the same address.
